descriptionByLocale.en:
Due to continued sales success, Zurich is looking for a Regional Income Development Executive to support the sales efforts in our Indiana market. This territory includes the states of Indiana, Ohio and may include parts of Michigan. The ideal candidate will live in the territory.

Zurich Direct Markets specializes in providing Finance & Insurance (F&I) products, to the automotive industry. We have a dedicated sales force of F&I professionals who meet regularly and directly with our customers.

Our Regional Income Development Executives support growth and profitability in an assigned region through sales related to Finance & Insurance book of business to maintain profitable relationships with new and existing customers. They will also:

- Cultivate relationships and assist in driving production in current accounts and obtaining referrals for new F&I business opportunities in the Large Franchised Automotive Dealers space

- Support performance and key initiatives to help drive growth and profitability through ongoing training and development within the dealerships

- Communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders via the relevant medium – e-mail/intranet/newsletter to maintain good relationships.

- Attend conferences, seminars, training events and other meetings to promote Zurich’s marketing efforts, as needed

- Understand and respond to changing technology/IT requirements of customer accounts and gain internal buy-in to maintain good relationships.

- Work from home in an entrepreneurial atmosphere

- Earn a competitive base salary with a generous no cap incentive plan

- Receive excellent benefits and a company car (All candidates are subject to a driving record check)

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the sales area

OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the sales area

Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong knowledge of principles of sales, sales techniques, and sales terminology

- Dealership training experience

- Advanced knowledge of technology within the dealership

- Basic knowledge of all F&I products

- Knowledge of techniques and terminology of warranty claims

- Ability to multi-task

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

This position included a variable component that is based on an individual's performance under the applicable sales incentive plan. The annual variable compensation range, based on performance under the sales incentive plan for this role, is $130,000 - $160,000.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

At Zurich North America Claims we acknowledge that work life balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA Claims hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing claims employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected.

The candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into one of the following North American Claims offices: Atlanta, GA; Schaumburg, IL; Overland Park, KS; Parsippany, NJ; Rocky Hill, CT; or Dallas, TX.

About the Role:

Zurich is currently seeking an individual interested in growing their career with our General Liability team. As a General Liability (GL) Claims Specialist, you will work with a diverse team of claims professionals. This environment will support your development as you enhance your technical skills in GL policy interpretation and coverage analysis to effectively resolve claims.

Key Responsibilities:

- Handle non-litigated GL claims of low to moderate exposure and complexity, such as slip/trip and falls, product liability, and other third-party injuries resulting from premises liability exposures.

- Manage a caseload within specified authority limits from beginning to end with coaching and supervision.

- Collaborate and develop partnerships with internal and external points of contact, including customers, vendors, suppliers, and brokers, to provide quality claims experience.

- Learn and develop knowledge of established protocols and industry best practices to ensure efficient, effective, and customer-centric claims handling.

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and 2 or more years of experience in Claims Handling or Insurance; OR

- Completion of Zurich Claims Training Program and 2 or more years of experience in the Claims or Insurance area OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree with 2 or more years of experience in Claims Handling or Insurance; OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in Claims Handling or Insurance.

Additional Requirements:

- Must obtain and maintain required adjuster license(s).

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Knowledge of insurance regulations, markets, and products.

Preferred Qualifications:

- General liability claims handling experience.

- Active adjuster's license.

- Experience collaborating across work groups.

- Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships.

- Understanding of the claims adjustment process and ability to determine scope/exposure for losses.

- Knowledge of vendor utilization and litigation strategy development.

- Financial and actuarial/reserving concepts comprehension.

- Familiarity with negotiation strategies and alternative approaches.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Customer service experience.

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us.

The pay range shown is a national average and may vary by location. The proposed salary range for this position is $49,500.00 - 81,000.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 10%.

Das ZNA Claims Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell, das auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitarbeiter ausgerichtet ist, betont Flexibilität und ermöglicht es den Mitarbeitern, individuelle Arbeiten an ihrem bevorzugten Standort durchzuführen, während persönliche Verbindungen und kollaborative Aktivitäten erleichtert werden, wenn sie sinnvoll und wertvoll sind. Während das Modell ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität und Autonomie bietet, sollten gelegentliche Umstände erwartet werden, die eine Anwesenheit im Büro erfordern.

Der für diese Gelegenheit ausgewählte Kandidat sollte in der Lage sein, sich in einem der folgenden nordamerikanischen Claims-Büros zu melden: Atlanta, GA; Schaumburg, IL; Overland Park, KS; Parsippany, NJ; Rocky Hill, CT; oder Dallas, TX.

Über die Rolle:

Zürich sucht derzeit eine Person, die sich für die Weiterentwicklung ihrer Karriere mit unserem General Liability Team interessiert. Als General Liability (GL) Claims Specialist arbeiten Sie mit einem vielfältigen Team von Claim Professionals zusammen. Diese Umgebung wird Ihre Entwicklung unterstützen, da Sie Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in der Interpretation von GL-Richtlinien und der Abdeckungsanalyse verbessern, um Ansprüche effektiv zu lösen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

- Behandeln Sie nicht prozessierte GL-Forderungen mit geringer bis mittlerer Exposition und Komplexität, wie z. B. Ausrutscher / Fahrt und Stürze, Produkthaftung und andere Verletzungen durch Dritte, die sich aus Haftungsrisiken in Gebäuden ergeben.

- Verwalten Sie eine Caseload innerhalb bestimmter Autoritätsgrenzen von Anfang bis Ende mit Coaching und Supervision.

- Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung von Partnerschaften mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern, einschließlich Kunden, Lieferanten, Lieferanten und Brokern, um eine Erfahrung mit Qualitätsansprüchen zu bieten.

- Lernen und entwickeln Sie Kenntnisse über etablierte Protokolle und Best Practices der Branche, um eine effiziente, effektive und kundenorientierte Schadenbearbeitung zu gewährleisten.

Grundqualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss und 2 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in Claims Handling oder Versicherung; ODER

- Abschluss des Zurich Claims Training Program und 2 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung im Claims- oder Versicherungsbereich OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice einschließlich eines Associate Degree mit 2 oder mehr Jahren Erfahrung in der Schadenbehandlung oder Versicherung; ODER

- High-School-Diplom oder gleichwertig und 4 oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in Claims Handling oder Versicherung.

Zusätzliche Anforderungen:

- Muss die erforderliche(n) Adjuster-Lizenz(en) erhalten und beibehalten.

- Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office.

- Kenntnis der Versicherungsvorschriften, Märkte und Produkte.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

- Allgemeine Haftungsansprüche im Umgang mit Erfahrung.

- Lizenz des aktiven Adjusters.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Arbeitsgruppen.

- Fähigkeit, starke Beziehungen zu entwickeln und aufrechtzuerhalten.

- Verständnis des Schadenanpassungsprozesses und der Fähigkeit, Umfang/Exposition für Verluste zu bestimmen.

- Kenntnis der Vendor Auslastung und Litigation Strategie Entwicklung.

- Finanz- und versicherungsmathematisches/reservierendes Verständnis.

- Vertrautheit mit Verhandlungsstrategien und alternativen Ansätzen.

- Starke organisatorische und Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten.

- Customer Service Erfahrung.

- Starke analytische, kritisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.

- Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Ihre Bezahlung in Zürich basiert auf Ihrer Rolle, Ihrem Standort, Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung. Wir befolgen lokale Gesetze, um eine faire Entschädigung zu gewährleisten. Möglicherweise haben sie auch anspruch auf boni und leistungssteigerungen. Wenn Ihre Erwartungen über dem aufgeführten Bereich liegen, empfehlen wir Ihnen dennoch, sich zu bewerben - Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund ist für uns wichtig.

Die gezeigte Lohnspanne ist ein nationaler Durchschnitt und kann je nach Standort variieren. Die vorgeschlagene Gehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt 49.500.00 $ - 81.000,00 $, wobei die kurzfristige Anreizbonusberechtigung bei 10% liegt.

Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung und umfassende Leistungen für Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien. [Erfahren Sie hier mehr über Total Rewards.]

Warum Zürich?

Bei Zurich schätzen wir Ihre Ideen und Erfahrungen. Wir bieten Wachstum, Inklusion und ein unterstützendes Umfeld - damit Sie die Zukunft der Versicherung mitgestalten können. Zurich North America ist führend im Risikomanagement und verfügt über mehr als 150 Jahre Erfahrung und Abdeckung in über 25 Branchen, darunter 90 % der Fortune 500®.

Begleiten Sie uns für eine bessere Zukunft – für Sie und unsere Kunden.

The Opportunity

Are you looking for a caring, collaborative, values-driven workplace with inspiring teammates and leaders? Do you have the ambition and desire to be the best and thrive at the most impactful global insurance provider in the world? Look no further than Zurich Canada.

If you have experience in Service Delivery within Commercial Underwriting and are looking for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you.

Zurich Canada is currently looking for a Multinational Services Manager to provide leadership in managing all servicing and operation activities, as well and related support, for our Middle Market & Specialties Multinational Business Unit. In this role, the Multinational Services Manager will liaise with internal & external stakeholders as well as with colleagues around the globe to manage all operational & servicing activities or aspects associated with the delivery of a best-in-class customer experience.

This is a unique opportunity to build your knowledge and experience for the future in a supportive environment where your voice matters. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.

Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in-person presence, which may include time in the office or market-facing engagements.

What you will do

• Directly responsible for attainment of service goals, including the achievement of production timeliness and quality standards for all supported areas.
• Direct responsibility for a team of Multinational Service Specialists who are responsible for all Multinational Business Servicing and Compliance
• Manages established performance metrics, prepares and manages within operational budgets, and responds to changing requirements
• Demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset
• Manage relationships with business partners, creating a positive, collaborative and customer-led team environment.
• Build and maintain strong broker relationships and act as a key operational contact for Multinational servicing.
• Deliver external broker trainings and presentations to support understanding of Zurich’s Multinational capabilities and servicing approach.
• Ensures compliance with all organizational standards and guidelines.
• Is responsible for managing others, including staffing, recruiting, performance management, coaching / counseling, staff development, training & leadership.
• Plans and executes strategic vision.
• Develops and maintains strong, positive Business Unit relationships. Troubleshoots problem areas; resolves problems

Job Qualifications - What you bring to the table

Required:

• Bachelors Degree, and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting area

OR

• High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting area

AND

• Ability to travel for business
• Valid Driver's License

Preferred:

• Experience in a Multinational Insurance environment

At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation based on objective criteria such as skills, experience, and internal equity. The salary range for this position is 81,000 – 131,000. This range reflects the expected pay for the role across Canada and may vary depending on factors like office location, specific responsibilities, and individual qualifications. As required by local law, Zurich provides in good faith a reasonable compensation range, but starting salaries may exceed this range based on a candidate’s skills and experience.

Our Culture

• At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.

• We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.

• We care about our employees’ well-being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.

• We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.

• We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.

• We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.

• We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.

• We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5-Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About Us

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid-sized and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in-depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com

A future with Zurich

Now is the time to move forward and make a difference. At Zurich, we want you to share your unique perspectives, experiences and ideas so we can grow and drive sustainable change together. As part of a leading global organization, Zurich North America has over 148 years of experience managing risk and supporting resilience. We are a leading provider of commercial property-casualty insurance solutions and a wide range of risk management products and services for businesses and individuals. Today, we serve more than 25 industries, from agriculture to technology and insure 90% of the Fortune 500®. Our growth strategy is not limited to our business. As an employer, Zurich strives to provide ongoing career development opportunities and foster an environment where voices are diverse, behaviors are inclusive, actions drive equity, and our people feel a sense of belonging. Be a part of the next evolution of the insurance industry. Join us in building a brighter future for our people, our customers and the communities we serve.

As a global company, Zurich recognizes the diversity of our workforce as an asset. We recruit talented people from a variety of backgrounds with unique perspectives that are truly welcome here. Taken together, diversity and inclusion bring us closer to our common goal: exceeding our customers’ expectations. Zurich is committed to providing a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free environment resulting in an accessible organization for employees, customers, and other parties who interact with, or on behalf of, Zurich. We strive to achieve a workplace free of discrimination of all forms, including discrimination on the basis of physical or mental disability, or medical condition. If you are interested in a job opportunity, please advise if you require an accommodation, so we can work with you to provide a more accessible process.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Any unsolicited resume will become the property of Zurich Canadian Holdings Limited. If you are a preferred vendor, please use our Recruiting Agency Portal for resume submission.

L'opportunità

Stai cercando un posto di lavoro attento, collaborativo e orientato ai valori con compagni di squadra e leader ispiranti? Hai l'ambizione e il desiderio di essere il migliore e prosperare presso il fornitore di assicurazioni globali più efficace nel mondo? Non guardare oltre Zurigo Canada.

Se avete esperienza nel servizio di consegna all'interno della sottoscrizione commerciale e siete alla ricerca di una nuova sfida, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Zurigo Canada è attualmente alla ricerca di un Multinational Services Manager per fornire la leadership nella gestione di tutte le attività di assistenza e di funzionamento, nonché il relativo supporto, per la nostra Middle Market & Specialties Multinational Business Unit. In questo ruolo, il Multinational Services Manager si occuperà di stakeholder interni ed esterni, nonché di colleghi di tutto il mondo per gestire tutte le attività operative e di assistenza o gli aspetti associati alla consegna di un'esperienza di cliente migliore in classe.

Questa è un'opportunità unica per costruire la vostra conoscenza ed esperienza per il futuro in un ambiente di supporto in cui la vostra voce conta. Questa pubblicazione è per un posto vacante esistente.

Zurigo Canada utilizza strumenti di intelligenza artificiale abilitati a sostenere alcuni aspetti del processo di reclutamento, tra cui la revisione iniziale e la screening delle applicazioni. L'intelligenza artificiale non è l'unica base per la shortlist o la selezione dei candidati. Tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono esaminate e prese da professionisti qualificati di assunzione.

Zurigo segue un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede tre giorni alla settimana di presenza in persona, che può includere il tempo in ufficio o gli impegni di mercato.

Cosa farai

• Direttamente responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di servizio, compreso il raggiungimento di tempistiche di produzione e standard di qualità per tutte le aree supportate.
• Responsabilità diretta di un team di specialisti del servizio multinazionale responsabile di tutti i servizi multinazionali
• Gestisce metriche di performance consolidate, prepara e gestisce all'interno di budget operativi e risponde alle mutevoli esigenze
• Dimostrare una mentalità di miglioramento continuo
• Gestisci i rapporti con i partner commerciali, creando un ambiente di team positivo, collaborativo e orientato al cliente.
• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni broker e agire come un contatto operativo chiave per il servizio multinazionale.
• Fornire formazione e presentazioni di broker esterni per supportare la comprensione delle capacità multinazionali di Zurigo e l'approccio di assistenza.
• Assicura il rispetto di tutti gli standard e le linee guida organizzative.
• È responsabile della gestione di altri, tra cui personale, reclutamento, gestione delle prestazioni, coaching / consulenza, sviluppo del personale, formazione e leadership.
• Pianifica ed esegue la visione strategica.
• Sviluppa e mantiene relazioni solide e positive Business Unit. Risoluzione dei problemi aree; risolve i problemi

Qualifiche di lavoro - Cosa porti al tavolo

Richiesto:

• Corso di laurea, e 5 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di sottoscrizione

O

• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente e 7 o più anni di esperienza nella zona di sottoscrizione

E

• Capacità di viaggiare per affari
• Licenza valida del driver

Preferito:

• Esperienza in un ambiente di assicurazione multinazionale

A Zurigo Canada, siamo impegnati a pagare l'equità. Determinamo la compensazione in base a criteri oggettivi quali competenze, esperienza e equity interna. La fascia salariale per questa posizione è 81.000 – 131.000. Questa gamma riflette la retribuzione prevista per il ruolo in tutto il Canada e può variare a seconda di fattori come la posizione dell'ufficio, responsabilità specifiche e qualifiche individuali. Come richiesto dal diritto locale, Zurigo fornisce in buona fede un range di compensazione ragionevole, ma gli stipendi iniziali possono superare questa gamma in base alle competenze e all’esperienza di un candidato.

La nostra cultura

• A Zurigo siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura. Siamo appassionati di Diversità, Inclusione, Equità e Belonging (DIEB). Vogliamo che tu porti tutto il tuo lavoro, e vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti siano riflessivi delle comunità in cui viviamo e lavoriamo. Le nostre iniziative DIEB stanno creando un ambiente in cui tutti si sentono benvenuti.

• Abbiamo una cultura collaborativa dove la diversità del pensiero è apprezzata. Apprezziamo il vostro contributo e ci sforziamo di dare ai nostri dipendenti gli strumenti di cui hanno bisogno per fare un impatto.

• Ci preoccupiamo del benessere dei nostri dipendenti e offriamo un piano completo di salute/benefici con diversi livelli di copertura per soddisfare le vostre esigenze specifiche e un pacchetto di compensazione totale competitivo.

• Sappiamo quanto sia importante riposare, ricaricare e fare le cose che ami. A Zurigo, tutti i dipendenti ricevono un minimo di quattro settimane di vacanza all'anno per farlo.

• Sappiamo anche che i dipendenti richiedono tempo libero per motivi personali. Forse avete un appuntamento durante una giornata di lavoro, una vacanza culturale o religiosa che si desidera osservare, o avete bisogno di tempo libero per concentrarsi sulla vostra salute mentale. I dipendenti di Zurigo ricevono quattro giorni all'anno per essere utilizzati a loro discrezione.

• Siamo impegnati a un miglioramento continuo e offriamo l'accesso a una gamma completa di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo.

• Ci preoccupiamo delle nostre comunità. Le nostre comunità sono dove vivono e lavorano i nostri clienti, persone e azionisti. Mentre possiamo essere orgogliosi del contributo alla società che Zurigo fa attraverso il nostro core business dell'assicurazione, dobbiamo anche restituire alle nostre comunità attraverso il nostro talento, il tempo e le risorse.

• Abbiamo vinto numerosi premi per la nostra cultura del posto di lavoro. Siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei più grandi datori di lavoro di Toronto e di aver ricevuto il premio per la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione di Insurance Business Canada.

Fai la differenza. Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Sii supportato. Adoro quello che fai. Lavora per noi.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo Canada fa parte del Zurich Insurance Group, un'assicurazione multi-linea con circa 55.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo che servono clienti nei mercati globali e locali. Zurigo Canada è stato un fornitore di assicurazioni leader che serve società di medie e grandi dimensioni, comprese le multinazionali, nel mercato commerciale canadese per 100 anni. Con oltre 650 dipendenti in uffici in tutto il paese, Zurigo offre la forza globale di un fornitore di assicurazione superiore combinato con la conoscenza approfondita delle industrie e dei mercati locali. Zurigo Canada aspira ad essere la prima scelta dei professionisti della gestione del rischio come partner principale per soddisfare le sfide di rischio di oggi e domani. Leggi tutto su www.zurichcanada.com

Un futuro con Zurigo

Ora è il momento di andare avanti e fare la differenza. A Zurigo, vogliamo che tu condivida le tue prospettive, esperienze e idee uniche in modo da poter crescere e guidare un cambiamento sostenibile insieme. Nell'ambito di un'organizzazione globale leader, Zurigo Nord America ha oltre 148 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio e nel supporto alla resilienza. Unsere Kultur

Unsere DIEB-Initiativen schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder willkommen fühlt.

Zurich suit un modèle de travail hybride exigeant trois jours par semaine de présence en personne, ce qui peut inclure du temps dans le bureau ou des engagements face au marché.

Ce que vous ferez

• Responsable direct de la réalisation des objectifs de service, y compris la réalisation des délais de production et des normes de qualité dans tous les domaines soutenus.
• Responsabilité directe d'une équipe de spécialistes des services multinationaux qui sont responsables de tous les services multinationaux aux entreprises et de la conformité
• Gérer les paramètres de rendement établis, préparer et gérer dans les budgets opérationnels et répondre aux besoins changeants
• Démontrer un état d'esprit en constante amélioration
• Gérer les relations avec les partenaires commerciaux, créer un environnement d'équipe positif, collaboratif et dirigé par le client.

• Assurer le respect de toutes les normes et lignes directrices organisationnelles.

• Développer et maintenir des relations solides et positives entre les unités opérationnelles. Résolution des problèmes

OU

• Expérience dans un environnement d'assurance multinational

Comme l'exige le droit local, Zurich fournit de bonne foi une fourchette de rémunération raisonnable, mais les salaires de départ peuvent dépasser cette fourchette en fonction des compétences et de l'expérience d'un candidat.

Notre culture

• À Zurich, nous sommes fiers de notre culture. Nous sommes passionnés par la diversité, l'inclusion, l'équité et l'appartenance (DIEB). Nous voulons que vous mettiez tout votre moi au travail, et nous voulons que nos employés reflètent les communautés dans lesquelles nous vivons et travaillons. Nos initiatives DIEB créent un environnement où tout le monde se sent bienvenu.

• Nous avons une culture de collaboration où la diversité de pensée est appréciée. Nous apprécions vos commentaires et nous nous efforçons de donner à nos employés les outils dont ils ont besoin pour avoir un impact.

• Nous nous soucions du bien-être de nos employés et offrons un régime complet de soins de santé et d'avantages sociaux avec des niveaux de couverture variables pour répondre à vos besoins spécifiques et un régime de rémunération totale concurrentiel.

• Nous comprenons combien il est important de se reposer, de se recharger et de faire ce que vous aimez. À Zurich, tous les employés reçoivent un minimum de quatre semaines de vacances par année pour ce faire.

• Nous comprenons également que les employés ont besoin de congés pour des raisons personnelles. Peut-être que vous avez un rendez-vous pendant une journée de travail, une fête culturelle ou religieuse que vous souhaitez observer, ou vous avez besoin de temps libre pour vous concentrer sur votre santé mentale. Les employés de Zurich reçoivent quatre jours personnels par an à leur discrétion.

Bien que nous puissions être fiers de la contribution de Zurich à la société grâce à notre activité principale d'assurance, nous devons aussi redonner à nos communautés par notre talent, notre temps et nos ressources.
